t5._comment: The team's checkpoint (thesis_hybrid_dataset1/model), received 2026-09-25. `team`'s limits are copied from the team notebook / training_metadata.json and stay pinned -- it must reproduce their exact generate() call. `guarded` is what the browser (apps/web/speech.html) and export_speech.py deploy. `generate.*` dicts are unpacked straight into model.generate()/the browser's beam search, so they hold only real generate() kwargs -- no _comment keys here; see `guarded_note` below for guarded's 2026-09-25 tuning.
t5.guarded_note: num_beams 4->2, max_length 64->56 (2026-09-25, TODO §13: browser inference time). Benchmarked on the real checkpoint, 40 sentences: beams=2 is ~16% faster than beams=4 and keeps guard-acceptance near-identical (23/40 vs 24/40, 33/40 outputs byte-identical to beams=4); beams=1 was ~50% faster but guard-acceptance dropped more (19/40). max_length 56 keeps margin above this checkpoint's observed max gloss length (55 tokens over 330 sentences, p99 44) while bounding the rare non-terminating (prompt-echoing) case.
